items.title: Dansk TikTok-chef om hemmelige koder: »Det er svært for os at finde ud af«
items.summary: Trods undersøgelser, der viser, at problematisk indhold flyder på TikTok, kalder dansk chef det for et sikkert sted. Men én ting har platformen svært ved at dæmme op for.
items.titleEn: Danish TikTok boss on secret codes:  ⁇ It's hard for us to find out ⁇
items.summaryEn: Despite studies showing that problematic content flows on TikTok, the Danish boss calls it a safe place. But there's one thing the platform is having a hard time stopping.

items.title: Irans præstestyre pisker kendt sanger, men krisen forværres
items.summary: Mens risikoen for ny krig vokser, strammer regimet i Teheran grebet om sin befolkning. Vreden vokser, men regimet holder fast – og Donald Trump tøver, skriver Anders Jerichow i denne nyhedsanalyse.
items.titleEn: Iran's clergy whip well-known songs, but the crisis worsen
items.summaryEn: As the risk of a new war grows, the regime in Tehran is tightening its grip on its population. Anger is rising, but the regime is holding on  ⁇  and Donald Trump is hesitating, writes Anders Jerichow in this news analysis.

items.title: Joachim B. Olsen spurgte igen og igen statsministeren: »Står du ved de ting, du sagde, i din samtale med mig?«
items.summary: Enhedslisten markerer en »meget klar rød linje« efter statsministerens brug af ordet »befolkningsudskiftning«. Alternativet truer med at trække støtten til regeringen.
items.titleEn: Joachim B. Olsen asked the Prime Minister again and again: "Do you remember the things you said in your conversation with me?"
items.summaryEn: The unit list marks a very clear red line after the Prime Minister's use of the word 'population replacement'. The alternative threatens to withdraw support for the government.

items.title: Han benytter sig af et enkelt, men originalt greb

items.title: Amerikanske politikere raser: Trumps genindsættelse af Jensen Huang udgør en fare for USA

items.title: Elisabet Svane: Mette Frederiksens stædighed kender tilsyneladende ingen grænser
items.summary: Statsminister Mette Frederiksen vil ikke beklage sin brug af ordet »befolkningsudskiftning«. Hun gør i stedet det, som hun er en mester i, skriver politisk analytiker Elisabet Svane i denne nyhedsanalyse.
items.titleEn: Elisabeth Swane: The stubbornness of Mette Frederick seems to have no limits
items.summaryEn: Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen will not regret using the word 'population replacement'. Instead, she is doing what she is a master at, writes political analyst Elisabet Svane in this news analysis.

items.title: Christian Egander Skov tror, han ved, hvad Mette Frederiksen mente med »befolkningsudskiftning«
items.summary: Det har skabt opmærksomhed, at Mette Frederiksen har omfavnet højreradikalismens sprogbrug. Men i substansen er hun næppe langt fra vælgerne.
items.titleEn: Christian Egander Skov thinks he knows what Mette Frederiksen meant by population replacement.
items.summaryEn: It has attracted attention that Mette Frederiksen has embraced the language of right-wing radicalism. But in substance, she's hardly far from the electorate.

items.title: Det er afsløringen, der kan slå revner i Putins propaganda. Nye russiske dødstal slår alle rekorder
items.summary: Analyse: Det er den hidtil bedst dokumenterede afsløring af russiske tabstal. Antallet af dræbte russiske soldater er markant højere, end vi troede.
items.titleEn: It's the disclosure that could tear apart Putin's propaganda. New Russian death toll breaks all records
items.summaryEn: Analysis: This is the best-documented disclosure of Russian losses to date. The number of Russian soldiers killed is significantly higher than we thought.

items.title: På svensk eliteskole gik en golfkølle og et skohorn i arv: Skulle bruges til at straffe yngre elever, lyder anklagen
items.summary: En roman om en ond kostskole i 1950erne har tilsyneladende inspireret elever på den fine kostskole Sigtunaskolan Humanistiska Läroverket. Seks afgangselever er anklaget for at have uddelt grove straffe til de yngre.
items.titleEn: Swedish elite school inherited a golf club and a shoe horn:
items.summaryEn: A novel about an evil boarding school in the 1950s has apparently inspired students at the fine boarding school Sigtunaskolan Humanistiska Läroverket. Six former students are charged with distributing harsh sentences to the younger students.

items.summaryEn: Like 3,000 other young Danes, Julie Knuth Brøllund Hansen has arthritis. When she was diagnosed, her life was turned upside down. Today, she has learned to live with the disease, which has given her important insight.

items.title: Alle taler om Jensen Huangs sexskandale. Men hvem er kvinden, han forrådte? Mød Lori Huang

items.titleEn: Everyone is talking about the Jensen Huang sex scandal. But who is the woman he betrayed? Meet Lori Huang
items.summaryEn: For 41 years, Lori Huang has stood beside one of the most powerful men in the world without even seeking the spotlight. Now she's become the protagonist of a global narrative of infidelity, power, espionage, money and humiliation.
